purpose: Show what paying unlocks and let the user choose a plan.
layout: A short benefit headline, 3–4 benefits with checkmarks, plan options as selectable cards (the recommended one marked), then the subscribe button and restore / terms in small text.

required: Selectable plan cards with price and period

primaryAction.note: Full-width subscribe button naming the trial or price.

avoid: Pre-selecting the most expensive plan without marking it
